title: Iberia Parish Clean Energy Hub Digital Twin
tagline: Make clean-energy, resilience, environmental, and infrastructure context visible at community scale.
overview: The Iberia Parish experience brings community-scale aerial context, local destinations, infrastructure, and environmental data into one digital twin. It is connected to the Iberia Parish Clean Energy Hub initiative in the National Academies' Gulf Futures Challenge.

project.name: Iberia Parish Clean Energy Hub - Gulf Futures Challenge
project.kind: Gulf Futures Challenge finalist project / digital twin pilot
project.blurb: The Iberia Parish digital twin is designed to make place-based clean-energy and resilience concepts easier to explore. Supplied imagery shows a location-navigation menu, community-scale 3D aerial views, an environmental surface-temperature visualization, and industrial/transportation infrastructure context. Within the Iberia Parish Clean Energy Hub initiative, the digital twin component supports a broader concept integrating solar, agrivoltaics, carbon capture, workforce training, environmental restoration, and community resilience.

capturedWith: Aerial/3D spatial capture combined with map, GIS, location, infrastructure, and environmental data layers.
